description: A class describing a shape (PEP 544); any class with those members matches it without inheriting.
Structural types match by members, nominal types by inheritance. Python classes and ABCs are nominal; protocols are structural.
Lets `isinstance` and `issubclass` test a protocol; it checks that the members exist, never their signatures or types.
Returns the frozenset of member names a protocol requires (Python 3.13).
A nominal base class whose abstract methods must be overridden before instantiation; good for shared implementation you own.
